sentences.en: Man is as fickle as autumn weather.
sentences.zh: 人的感情就像秋天的天气一样易变。

sentences.en: I'll eat almost anything, but I'm very fickle when it comes to cheese.
sentences.zh: 我几乎什么都吃，但说到奶酪我就很挑。

sentences.en: A woman is ever fickle and changeable.

senses.zh: (爱情或友谊上)易变的，不坚定的
易变的：likely to change；不忠诚的：
